# ALL IN ONE — Free Client-Side Web Utilities Suite

> ALL IN ONE (https://sami12901.github.io/ALL-IN-ONE-v1/) is an ultra-fast, 100% client-side suite of 424+ free online web tools, utilities, and calculators. Zero tracking, zero signup, 100% private, runs entirely inside the user's browser, and works offline as a progressive web app (PWA).

## Core Pages
- [ALL IN ONE Homepage](https://sami12901.github.io/ALL-IN-ONE-v1/): Primary tools dashboard with live category filtering and keyboard search
- [HTML Sitemap](https://sami12901.github.io/ALL-IN-ONE-v1/sitemap.html): Complete crawlable directory of all 424+ active tools organized by category
- [About ALL IN ONE](https://sami12901.github.io/ALL-IN-ONE-v1/pages/about.html): Frameworkless client-side architecture, security, and developer information
- [Support & Feedback](https://sami12901.github.io/ALL-IN-ONE-v1/pages/contact.html): Bug reports, contact form, and feature suggestions
- [Privacy Policy](https://sami12901.github.io/ALL-IN-ONE-v1/pages/privacy.html): 100% local browser processing guarantee; zero server storage
- [Terms of Service](https://sami12901.github.io/ALL-IN-ONE-v1/pages/terms.html): Open MIT license and usage guidelines

## Technical Specifications & Architecture
- **Frameworkless Architecture**: Built using pure modern HTML5, CSS3, and Vanilla JavaScript with Web Components (<app-header>, <app-breadcrumbs>, <app-footer>).
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: All calculations, text processing, media conversions, and document parsing run strictly locally via HTML5 Web APIs, Canvas, Web Audio, and WebAssembly. No data leaves the client device.
- **Offline Progressive Web App (PWA)**: Includes Service Worker caching and Web App Manifest for complete offline access and desktop/mobile installation.
